methodology.construction: Eleven named signals per stock (MACD, RSI, SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, Bull/Bear Power, Supertrend, Ichimoku, Keltner, ADX, Parabolic SAR), each graded Strong Buy / Buy / Neutral / Sell / Strong Sell (Bull/Bear Power uses its Bullish vocabulary). The overall score averages the signal votes (+1 / +0.5 / 0 / -0.5 / -1) over the ten non-BBP signals plus Bull/Bear Power only when it is not at a Strong extreme, mapped to 0-100 as round(50 x (1 + mean)). Indicator values are the standard textbook definitions with three fitted variants: Stochastic %K is the slow K (SMA-3 of raw %K 14), Supertrend (10, x3) runs on ATR(10), Keltner = EMA20 +/- 2 x ATR(10). The Bollinger state (Squeeze / Normal / Expansion) is the current band width's percentile inside its own trailing 126-session distribution — lowest fifth, middle, highest fifth.
methodology.crosscheck: Cross-checked on the shared session 2026-10-16 against the reference board this feature rebuilds and against the official exchange snapshot: every comparable closing price on this board matches the reference warehouse exactly (264/264) and the official top gainer matches to the hundredth (CKHL +14.82%). Indicator values agree to a median absolute difference of 0.00-0.004 on 91% of symbols; the MACD label rule and the overall score construction reproduce the reference exactly on the sampled symbols (MACD 282/282 label runs on their values; overall score 20/20 detail samples; rating bands 281/282 on the full board). On about 9% of symbols the reference runs visibly hotter on momentum (e.g. NABIL RSI 81 against 54 here): its history is corporate-action adjusted, ours is as-traded, and an ex-date step inside the smoothing window (NABIL fell 6.2% mechanically on its 30 September 2026 book closure) depresses Wilder readings for weeks. Rows carrying such a step inside the last 60 sessions are flagged on this page rather than silently absorbed. End-to-end label agreement (our values, our rules) runs 51-94% per signal, highest for Ichimoku (94%) and MACD (94%), lowest for ADX (51%) — the residual is the adjustment basis above plus two labels (RSI, ADX) whose reference form carries a momentum input no public snapshot exposes; those two rules are published here as our definitions.
methodology.prices: Nepse Decode OHLC archive; the adjusted side-collection (final revised closes) overlays the raw archive wherever it covers a symbol. The raw archive's 2026-10-14 bars are a preliminary vintage — boards priced off them run about half a percent hot market-wide.
methodology.replay_method: Forward replay on the same archive: at every session in the era, labels are computed from bars up to that session only (no lookahead) and the close-to-close return 5 and 10 sessions later is recorded. A firing is dropped when its forward window contains a single-session move over 15% (a likely corporate action in the unadjusted leg of the archive). A bullish label "hits" when the forward return is positive; a bearish label hits when it is negative. Counts are label-days; overlapping windows are not thinned.
methodology.tracking: Every published board is archived in full (score, rating, close, rating streak, all 11 indicator labels), so each row carries its previous session's score and rating, its streak of consecutive sessions at the current rating, and whether it crossed from the Buy side to the Sell side or back in one step (a flip). Streaks are exact from the 2025-07-01 backfill start. A daily rating that flips the next day is noise, not a signal: the cohort ledger therefore splits every session's Strong Buy and Strong Sell cohorts into flash (first session at the rating) and persistent (3+ consecutive sessions) and reports each split's close-to-close return 5 and 10 sessions later against the whole board's equal-weight mean over the same window. Members whose forward window contains a bar-to-bar move over 15% are excluded as likely corporate actions, and a symbol that did not trade on the target session is measured at its last traded close on or before it. Until a cohort's window has passed its outcome stays pending — the page never fills it with a backtest rate.
methodology.honesty: These are mechanical indicator grades on past prices, published for education. The replay table is the measured record of what the grades were worth historically — read it before reading anything into a Strong Buy.
